name: Shepherd Alwyn

intro.text: Quiet, now. These ones have heard a lot of Cotswold Lions' gossip and they do not impress easily.

win: Well. That was loud. The sheep are going to talk about this for weeks.
after: Cotswold Lion fleece was the finest in medieval Europe. A bale of it was worth a small fortune. The sheep have never let it go to their heads.
